integrity: The classification is derived from exact center coordinates, an exact determinant factorization, and a sign-safe elimination. The explicit example is checked algebraically to be non-orthocentric and non-biregular. The motivating open-problem full texts and the cited orthocentric theorem were compared with targeted semantic and exact-form searches. Residual risk remains for unindexed or differently phrased prior work. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the displayed two-parameter reflection-symmetric tetrahedron family. It does not characterize all tetrahedra or higher-dimensional simplices, and it makes no moduli-space completeness claim beyond this family.
title: A non-orthocentric Euler-line branch in a reflection-symmetric tetrahedron family
